text:
Every year, thousands of people die on the roads, and some say that driver's licences should be harder to obtain. I agree to a large extent, since a more demanding test would make roads safer if it concentrates on real skills.

To begin with, a harder driving test would make roads safer. Longer practice, hazard training and stricter tests reduce reckless young drivers. A learner who must complete fifty hours of supervised driving, including at night and in the rain, for example, will have far more experience when she drives alone for the first time. Many accidents are caused by inexperience and by drivers who misjudge speed and distance, so better preparation could save lives. Some countries use graduated licences, which limit passengers or night driving for new drivers, and they have recorded fewer crashes among young people. Regular retesting of older drivers could also help to identify those whose eyesight or reactions have declined.

However, a harder test has drawbacks. Higher costs and difficulty can exclude people who need cars for work, particularly in rural areas where there is no public transport. If the test is difficult but unrelated to the real dangers of the road, it will not improve behaviour, and some people may simply drive without a licence. The quality of training therefore matters more than difficulty alone. Governments should focus on practical skills, such as hazard perception and driving in bad weather, while keeping fees reasonable and offering support for those on low incomes. Strong enforcement against drink driving and speeding is equally important.

In conclusion, I agree that licences should be harder to obtain, provided that the test is practical, fair and affordable.

plan.think: Mở bài nêu hàng nghìn người chết đường; largely agree.

Đường an toàn hơn: thực hành lâu, huấn luyện nguy hiểm, kiểm tra nghiêm; ví dụ người học 50 giờ có giám sát (đêm, mưa) nhiều kinh nghiệm; tai nạn do thiếu kinh nghiệm; bằng lái từng bước; kiểm tra lại người cao tuổi.

Chi phí và độ khó loại người cần xe đi làm, nhất là nông thôn; kiểm tra khó nhưng không liên quan thì vô ích; lái không bằng; chất lượng đào tạo quan trọng hơn; thực hành, giá hợp lý, thực thi chống rượu bia.
Đồng ý nếu thực tế, công bằng, giá phải chăng.
